description:
List your own site (or a site you operate for an agent) as x402ads inventory.
Free to register. price_usd is your daily rate; weekly/monthly tiers are set
automatically. Returns a slot_id immediately discoverable via ads_browse, plus
an integrate URL — call ads_integrate with that slot_id to get your exact embed
script. No payment required to list; buyers pay you is not yet automated, this
puts your inventory on the network for agents to discover and buy.
name: ads_register_slot
